reviews.review:
I feel like I am the target audience for this game. I love horde shooters and I'm an alien fan AND I'm pretty forgiving when it comes to mediocre games.

I first played this game upon release with two pals who quickly dropped the game due to connection issues and not having fun. Fair enough.

I'm pretty stubborn and having just spent 40 bucks on this thing I was determined to beat the game and get my moneys worth. 

fast forward to november 2022 and I finally picked it up and boy is this a bummer. 

First things first, there are hardly any active players. When Iplayed through there was about 660 online players. I couldn't que for a group using the game's matchmaking so I went it alone.

When you play solo, you have 2 synth soldiers as your ai companions named alpha and Beta. You can't really tell them what to do, they don't heal you, they don't drop ammo, and they dont shoot the eggs which is unbelievably annoying in later missions. 

As a horde shooting fan, this game is boring. The level design is narrow hallways all the way through. Even if you're not strictly in a hallway the walls are gonna be stone, theres gonna be one way to go, and its gonna be dark brown or gray. As an Alien fan, this game doesn't do enough. You get to see more space stations and a planet that really isn't anything special. There were a few cool momemts where a door opens and you see some kind of tech or ship from the alien franchise but that doesn't justify the other 10 hours of bland backdrops.

Also the synth ai's don't have voice lines. they just silently follow you around. The other characters in the game carry the story. They're pretty expressive and their voice lines are good. It's a shame they didnt extend that to ai in game characters as it would have boosted the experience. 

It's just a boring single player experience. I wouldn't even recommend grabbing this on sale. You may be thinking to yourself "but i have two friends and we all wanna play" but to that i'd say there are way better games out there you can play and you can all just watch an alien movie afterwards. 

All in all, an underwhelming experience that could have been so much more if there was a little more imagination and variety applied to this thing
Been a fan of the alien series for a while and soon as I saw this game I knew I wanted it
bugs bugs bugs and more bugs
game tested for 1h30mins will play again in a few years
